integrity: The proof derives the polygonal p-objective directly from the defining support-function integral, uses published uniqueness only to force the critical point onto the reflection axis, proves strict convexity analytically, and separates the p=2 and p=3 minimizers by exact rational polynomial signs. The packaged checker replays those exact signs and independent numerical consistency checks.
scientific_limitations: The result is an explicit planar counterexample to parameter independence of finite-p Minkowski critical points. It does not classify the convex bodies whose finite-p critical points do coincide. A highly relevant 2015 paper on p-critical points could be inspected only partially through its public PDF endpoint, leaving a residual literature-access risk.
title: A trapezoid disproves parameter-independent \(p\)-critical points
